references.text: The previous verse provides context about not destroying fruit trees during a siege, which this verse builds upon with an exception for trees that do not bear fruit
Isaiah describes how the Lord will cut down the forest with an axe, using similar imagery about felling trees in warfare
Jeremiah describes cutting down trees and building a ramp against Jerusalem, directly parallel to the instruction to build siege ramps
Ezekiel is told to set up a siege against Jerusalem, including siege ramps, illustrating the practical application of siege techniques
The story of a small city that was besieged with large ramps, an example of siege methods mentioned in the law
The prophecy that the enemy shall not build a ramp against the city shows that siege ramps were standard warfare
